Yeah, I know but
Hey!
You made pancakes?
Okay, okay, but don't worry, because we also have cereals, muffins, waffles,

ref: 对，如果那个散兵坑是用三明治围起来的话。

ref: 你们知道我主张和平，我对战争没什么兴趣。

ref: 等到革命来临的那一天，我一定会把你们消灭光。

Oh my good God.
Continuing the countdown of your favorite meals. Tonight, No. 3, macaroni and cheese with cut up hot dogs.
ref: 快来倒数你最爱吃的食物吧。今晚，第三名，起司通心粉加切丁的热狗。

"The Way You Look Tonight" is on here.
You are just the sweetest.
Hey!
Hey!
Hey, guess what I'm doing tonight.
What?

Ohh, Monica, I am so excited for you.

ref: 是啊。我知道我列了两次盖尔·罗斯坦，但是她好……

Well actually, I didn't eat mine. It's still in the bathroom.

ref: 没关系，其实我也是面试人员，你起码能看到一张友善的脸。

Yeah.
I mean, no, no, don't you worry, I'm sure with your qualifications you won't need to sleep with some guy to get that job.
ref: 没有啦，假的假的，别担心，以你的资历，不用出卖肉体也能被录取。

src: Although, I might need some convincing.
Kidding! God, I feel wild today!
ref: 逗你的啦！天啊，我今天真亢奋！

Or maybe he was writing to tell her that he's changed his name, you know? Tell Monica I'm sorry.

ref: 天啊！有没有可能"抱歉"现在就坐在里面？

src: Hi! Hey!
Well, of course I do! My good friend Joey over here.
ref: 当然有！我的好朋友乔伊就是啊。

src: What's the charity?
ref: 慈善募款的主题是什么？

src: Does Ralph mumble when you're not paying attention?
ref: 他是不是都趁你不专心时故意喃喃自语？

Oh, Rachel and I have appointments to get our hair cut.
I want to see what he wants first.
Wait a minute, hold the phone! You're not Elizabeth's dad?!
ref: 等等，且慢！你不是伊丽莎白的爸爸吗？！

ref: 我很好。我得到警局去指认嫌犯的照片。

Colorado.
Okay.
Um, I'm not.
No, you didn't. The only thing that freaked me out was you saying that nothing could ever happen between us.
ref: 不，你没有。吓坏我的是你说我们不该有私人关系。

src: Yeah, so, please don't fire me for doing this.
ref: 对，请不要因为我这么做就炒我鱿鱼。

src: See buddy, that's all you need, a bunch of toothless guys hitting each other with sticks.
ref: 那正是你需要的，一群以棍子互打的无齿之徒。

src: He's open!
Shoot! Shoot! Shoot!
Hey, look, we're on that TV thing!
Tiger!Dragon!Iceberg!!Joseph, did you even study at all last night?

G-sharp?
No, but you're questioning my method!

src: Thank you.
you know none of my other student thought I was stupid.

ref: 行啊！你去跟你的专业老师学！你可别哭着来找我等大家听腻了《坏小子李洛布朗》！！

I know!
Okay.
Okay, you know when your in bed, with a woman.

ref: 脑袋里突然出现一些疯狂的画面，比如超级名模艾拉·麦克弗森，或是影印店的那个女孩。

ref: 我知道，但是突然之间，你妈忽然跃入脑海。

ref: 但这之后，你就完全没情绪了，而你正在做的事又不能停止。

src: So it's kinda like, you're, you know.
You know....You don't know!
You said...
Oh!
I just can't decide who she looks more alike, you or Rachel?
ref: 我不知道她长得更像你还是瑞秋？

Well, if you see him, tell him to pack his bags. We are going to Minsk.

Minsk. It's in Russia.
I know where Minsk is.

January first.
You wanted to see me, Professor Geller?

Joe! I'm glad I found you, I got an audition for you!

The actor who has the part doesn't know he might be fired.

ref: 是一部影集《麦克与起司》的主角。

ref: 天啊1如果你那么想要孩子，去偷一个吧！

ref: 你是怎么了？你什么时候这么喜欢孩子了？

ref: 我不是喜欢孩子。我是喜欢和你在一起。

We've always talked about having babies someday.

ref: 我没说非得是现在，但我觉得我们现在能应付得来。

We're really good.
Oh, did you catch him?!

ref: 他说：“很高兴认识你，葛兰达。”我当然不能说出真名。

ref: 你们也看到他走得像飞了！

src: He's gonna stick around and talk to the daughter he abandoned!
ref: 他会留下来跟他抛弃的女儿聊天吗！

ref: 我自称是弗兰西丝的遗嘱执行人。有事找他谈，我们待会约在咖啡馆见。

You used the Europe story!
That's the magic story you use when you wanna have sex!

ref: 妈妈早上打电话提醒我不要扎头发。你知道我的耳朵并最好看的地方吗？

ref: 抱歉，我迟到了，我找不到我的"耳圈"。

ref: 别说了！别说了！他的话说得慢，搞不好尿得快！好，我们快走！！

ref: 真不敢相信！你背着我这么做多久了？

Oh, it has a name?
Phoebe, don't get upset!
Okay! Too late! I'm leaving! Come on Chandler let's go!
ref: 好吧！太迟了！我要走了！来吧，钱德勒，我们走！

src: Well, Phoebe I thought I'dYeah, what the hell.
Oh, that's good. Maybe he'll hear you and pull the cord.
ref: 很好。他也许能听见你然后按下车铃。

src: Are you sure he didn't break it because it really hurts?
ref: 你肯定他没有捏断吗，我真的很痛？

ref: 没有，只有骨挫伤。还有，这是你戒指造成的刺伤。

src: Rachel, how did this happen?
Where?
I licked my arm, what?
ref: 我舔了我的手臂，怎么样？

src: So?
What did you just do?
You won't even taste it?
Not even if you just pretend that it's milk?
Aww!
Oh sure!Noo!
What?!
Ross, where did you get this?!
ref: 罗斯，这张桌子是哪里买的？！

ref: 哇！天呐，要是他们是抄袭我们的桌子，那张桌子一定不只值51美元。

ref: 这张连鸦片的味道都没有。

ref: 还不好说。她在休息，这是好兆头。

ref: 我不想骗你，罗斯，不太理想。

ref: 我在一边夹上发夹，似乎能阻止卷曲。

ref: 你的头发太好看了，会让她伤心。罗斯，你去看看她好了。

src: Of course the packaging does appeal to grown-ups and kids alike.
ref: 当然装母乳的容器很吸引大人与小孩。

src: Ross, you're being silly. I've tried it, it's no big deal. Just taste it.
ref: 罗斯，别傻了。我试过，没什么。快尝尝。

Cantaloupe juice.
Uh huh.
You can keep saying it, but it won't stop being true.
ref: 你再怎么重复这句话，也不会改变事实。

ref: 我不明白为什么葛瑞格和珍妮要给我们假的电话号码。

ref: 或许有人会给假电话号码，但没有人会给假名。

I still don't get it, we didn't do anything wrong.
I know! Although, you did tell an awful lot of jokes.

ref: 你说很好笑啊。快讲笑话吧！讲笑话！讲笑话！讲笑话！

Well maybe it was all of your questions.
ref: 可能是你问了太多问题害的。

Oh, I'll get it.
Wow! I usually get to know a girl a little better before I let her spoon me.

ref: 别激动，我们又不是要用插子。

ref: 你们看！壁纸有点褪色，没关系。地毯有点翘起来。硬木地板！！！

Hello.
Oh! Ooh! Oh Monica! It's so beautiful.
I know!!!
So, I'm here, ready to play.
Okay.
I brought a bunch of stuff for the house, so check it out.

src: What's this?
That's a dog, every house should have a dog.
ref: 狗狗，每栋房子都应该有只狗。

src: Not one that can pee on the roof.
ref: 不能大到可以在屋顶上撒尿。

ref: 它这么大也许是因为房子盖在辐射废料掩埋地上。

src: And is this in case the house sneezes?
ref: 这是防止房子打喷嚏用的吗？

I don't want a ghost.

ref: 谁都不想闹鬼！但是这里闹鬼，因为房子盖在印地安古坟场上。

src: Okay, obviously you don't know much about the U.S. government.
ref: 显然你太不了解美国政府了。

All right, I just got changed in thirty seconds so you can be alone with him. You'd better go for it.

Well, if you don't, I will.
Would you please go?
Hey, guys, guys, did you see my new, china cabinet?!

Watch, watch.
Ooohhhh!!
And, and!
Ahhhh!!
Hey, my Father's house does that!

Oh, I'm a duck! I go, "Quack, quack!" I'm happy all the time!

Wait, wait, wait!
Look, Monica
Look!

I bet this will work!

Yes, you did!
No I didn't!
You love me!
No I don't! Stop it! Stop it! Stop it! Stop it!
ref: 我不爱！别再说了！别再说了！别再说了！别再说了！

Hi, this is Monica from the plane?
ref: 我是飞机上跟你们见过面的莫妮卡？

ref: 听着，你给我的电话号码853。那是他们的旧号码！

Hey listen umm, how would you like to get together?

Okay, how about Sunday?
Okay umm, the week after that?
The week after that?
you know what, Greg?
We are good, interesting, funny people with

Oh, okay, I'm having another one!
This one doesn't hurt eitherOoh, yes it does!
Oh, I was kinda hoping that was it.
Yeah, I love you. Okay, bye!
That was Alice's mom, she said she left five hours ago. She should be here by now!

I guess I set up the video camera to try and entice Joey.

ref: 因为我是莫妮卡。生性龌龊。我跟踪男人，还保留他们的内裤。

God, oh it's just perfect!

Just let me finish, okay?
This isn't something that we just, we just impulsively decided in Vegas, this is something we both really want.

I'm gonna miss you!
